components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The booking action; at most one per opening.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 3px; background: #2b1f17; color: #f6efe2; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6b4a2f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b4a2f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The second, quieter way: learn more.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(246, 239, 226, 0.7); color: #2b1f17; border: 1px solid #6b4a2f; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: #2b1f17; color: #f6efe2; border-color: #2b1f17; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b4a2f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Link
components.description: Secondary actions as underlined walnut words instead of more buttons.
components.html: Đặt Lịch Xuyên Vấn Cùng Cô
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: #6b4a2f; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #94733a; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b4a2f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Booking form field: hairline, square, 16px text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2b1f17; font-size: 15px; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(62, 43, 30, 0.3); background: transparent; color: #2b1f17; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #5a4738; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #af8a50; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #af8a50; }

components.name: Hanging Scroll
components.description: Signature: a Cormorant phrase on a paper panel between two dark rods; three of them rise as a staircase on the home opening.
components.css: .ds-scrolls { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: flex-start; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 44px; color: #2b1f17; } .ds-scroll { position: relative; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 0.42em 0.28em 0.5em; background: linear-gradient(rgba(240, 232, 216, 0.92), rgba(240, 232, 216, 0.6)); } .ds-scroll:nth-child(1) { margin-top: 1.2em; } .ds-scroll:nth-child(2) { margin-top: 0.6em; } .ds-scroll::before, .ds-scroll::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -7px; right: -7px; height: 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: #4a3526; } .ds-scroll::before { top: -3px; } .ds-scroll::after { bottom: -3px; height: 4px; left: -4px; right: -4px; } .ds-scroll span { line-height: 1.08; }

components.name: Lineage Line
components.description: Signature: the lineage over a bronze hairline, the reign in spaced capitals beneath.

narrative.northStar: A painting in ink on dó paper
narrative.overview:
Every page is a sheet of warm dó paper with a Huế landscape washed onto it in ink, and the words are written onto the painting the way a scholar writes a colophon beside a scroll painting: left-aligned, unhurried, in a few deliberate voices. The paper is the background, the walnut-brown ink is the text, bronze is the thin gilt of a mount, and the painting carries the colour. Nothing glows, floats or competes; depth comes from the painting fading into the paper, not from shadows.

The register is quiet luxury for a lineage house: a client with a large budget should feel they have entered a study of the Nguyễn court's Khâm Thiên Giám, not a website. Space is generous, one idea occupies one screen, and boldness is spent in one place per page (on the home page, the three hanging scrolls). Motion is a single brush stroke at the opening, never a show.

There is one look only: light, paper and ink. There is no dark mode, by the owner's decision (2026-10-03).
keyCharacteristics: Warm dó paper ground, walnut and ink text, bronze only as a hairline ornament.
Two voices of type: Cormorant Garamond writes, Be Vietnam Pro informs.
Left-aligned text over Huế landscape paintings that fade into the paper.
Small 3px corners, hairline borders, almost no shadow.
One orchestrated moment per page; everything else is still.

rules.name: The Painting Carries the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface itself stays in paper, brown and bronze; any colour stronger than walnut comes from a painting or a portrait, never from a UI fill, gradient or badge.

rules.name: The Gilt Hairline Rule
rules.body: Bronze appears as lines a pixel or two thick, never as a filled area or as text.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Cormorant writes, Be Vietnam Pro informs; no third family enters the public site.

rules.name: The 14px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing read is under 14px and reading text is never under 16px; reading sizes are whole pixels.

rules.name: The Glued Phrase Rule
rules.body: Vietnamese compound words and brand terms never break across a line: glue them with a no-break space and break lines where the sense breaks.

rules.name: The Paper Doesn't Float Rule
rules.body: Cards, sections and buttons sit on the paper; a shadow is allowed only for something that truly lies above the page (header, menu, tool card).

dos: Do keep the page a light paper-and-ink sheet; colour comes from the paintings and portraits.
Do align text left on the shared clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px) margin.
Do use Cormorant for what is written and Be Vietnam Pro for what is read or done.
Do keep every touch target at least 44×44px and text contrast at least 4.5:1, including captions over paintings.
Do spend motion on one moment per page (the scrolls brushing in, a painting settling) and honour reduced motion; booking buttons and key text are visible immediately.
Do use the original logo file (public/images/logo-mark.png) untouched, with clear space around it.
Do show master portraits in natural colour.
donts: Don't add a dark mode or dark-toned sections beyond the ink footer.
Don't centre the main headings or the opening text.

Don't use fortune-telling imagery (crystal balls, zodiac wheels as decoration, tarot, mystical purple, star-and-moon kitsch), Chinese imperial red-and-gold, dragons as decoration, or Dunhuang figures.
Don't use SaaS or tech looks: gradient blobs, glassmorphism, neon, big rounded cards everywhere, bento grids, emoji.
Don't put prices or long descriptions on the first screen or in the three pillar cards on the home page.
Don't add pointer-following ripple effects or black-and-white portraits.
Don't fade or slide every section in; no bouncing, spinning, zooming, confetti or cursor trails, and never animate the logo.
Don't add a tracked uppercase eyebrow above every heading, an arrow after every link, or 01/02/03 markers on content that is not a sequence.
Don't animate layout properties (padding, width, height); change colour or transform instead.
